scope: read-only Render deployment, runtime and natural Cron log inspection after owner rotated API-Football key
conclusion: A fresh natural API-Football request after the web deployment returned HTTP 200 with no provider error. This confirms the current Cron path can access the provider at that observation time; it does not certify long-term stability or every API endpoint.
limitations: The earlier AUTH_OR_ACCESS event was before the web deployment finished and is not evidence against the rotated key.
Other provider connections, account plans, and all API-Football endpoints were not retested.
No production data, service settings, secrets, or schedules were changed by this verification.
